entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A time-travelling silver golem of Dominaria created by Urza, twice a planeswalker, a pacifist who sacrificed his spark for the greater good.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The artificer planeswalker who created Karn and whose spark Karn inherited.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: A co-creator of Karn who worried for his mental health.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: A Phyrexian whose heartstone gave Karn sentience.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A young Tolarian student who mistreated Karn, later ran the mana rig and persuaded him to talk strategy.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A senior student who named Karn and became his friend.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: The Capashen heir who reactivated Karn and wielded the Legacy against Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Sidar Kondo
entities.description: Gerrard's adoptive father.

entities.name: Vuel
entities.description: Kondo's son, who turned on his tribe and stole the Legacy.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: The captain who found the frozen Karn and stored him in the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Greven
entities.description: Volrath's lieutenant who captured Karn on Rath.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: The ruler of the Stronghold where Karn was tortured.

entities.name: Sliver Queen
entities.description: The hive-mind guarding Legacy artifacts, who let Karn take them.

entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: A Phyrexian general killed with Karn's help at Koilos.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The ruler of Phyrexia, slain by the Legacy.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A golem made from the Mirari who turned Argentum into Mirrodin and was undone by Karn.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A figure whose arrival on Argentum jarred Karn from his depression.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A nascent planeswalker Karn sent dreams to, later a Phyrexian praetor.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A planeswalker who gave his life and spark to free Karn from Phyrexian influence.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Sylvok outcast who cleansed Karn's body and later un-compleated Ajani and Nissa.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who tried to have Karn killed and later captured him.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who tortured Karn and was executed by him.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker with a Planar Bridge control mechanism in his chest, defeated by Karn's team.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon the Gatewatch fought in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who freed Karn, was compleated, and was later un-compleated.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker un-compleated by Melira and Karn.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A planeswalker who saved Karn's loose head.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who met Karn in Yavimaya.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group Karn aided against Bolas but never swore the oath with.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A planeswalker who distracted Tezzeret.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker who volunteered to close Bolas's Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A fighter who volunteered to shut down the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who gave the planeswalkers her spear.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A rogue planeswalker who brought Hazoret to aid the fight.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A dragon resurrected on Ravnica who received Hazoret's spear.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: In the Echoverse, the planeswalker who built Karn from gold; also Urza's brother in the main story.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: A character who collapsed the Koilos cavern on Karn.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An orb that began as a flawed probe, turned by Karn into the golem Memnarch.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: The Thran device Karn hid on the Mana Rig and urged the planeswalkers to detonate.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Urza's skyship that Karn frequently sailed on.

entities.name: Legacy
entities.description: The collection of artifacts Urza built to fight Phyrexia, partly incorporated into Karn's body.

entities.name: Mightstone and Weakstone
entities.description: Urza's powerstone eyes, which turned Karn into the first artificial planeswalker.

entities.name: Argentum
entities.description: A plane of mathematical perfection created by Karn, later transformed into Mirrodin.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metallic plane Memnarch made from Argentum, later New Phyrexia.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane Mirrodin became, where Karn was trapped and tortured.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The island academy where Karn was activated.

entities.name: Tolarian Temporal Disaster
entities.description: The time-machine failure that destroyed the academy.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Yawgmoth's invasion of Dominaria.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle on Ravnica against Bolas and the Dreadhorde.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion ended as New Phyrexia was consigned to the void.

entities.name: Echoverse Karn
entities.description: An alternate-reality gold Karn built by Mishra who forged Mirrodin as a peaceful plane.

events.summary: Urza and Barrin create Karn as a time-travel probe, giving him sentience with Xantcha's heartstone.
events.quote: Karn was created as a probe by Urza and Barrin to enable their time-travel experiments.

events.summary: Jhoira takes Karn from Teferi's harassment and names him Karn, a Thran word for mighty.
events.quote: She granted him the name Karn, a Thran word for "mighty" or "strength".

events.summary: Karn uses Urza's time machine to save Jhoira from a Phyrexian sleeper agent, causing the Tolarian Temporal Disaster.
events.quote: the time machine suffered a catastrophic failure and caused the Tolarian Temporal Disaster

events.summary: Karn returns with Urza and Barrin to rebuild Tolaria and finds Jhoira alive and Teferi trapped in a slow-time bubble.
events.quote: discovered Jhoira still alive, and Teferi trapped in a slow-time bubble

events.summary: Urza places a mental cap on Karn's memories, letting him recall only 20 years at a time.
events.quote: Urza acquiesced and placed a mental cap on Karn's memories, allowing him to recall only 20 years of his life at a time.

events.summary: Karn rescues young Gerrard Capashen from Phyrexian raids on Benalia and brings him to Sidar Kondo.
events.quote: The golem rescued young Gerrard Capashen from the Phyrexian raids on Benalia

events.summary: Karn is tricked into killing an innocent and frozen by the Touchstone; reactivated by Gerrard, he vows never to take a life.
events.quote: Karn took a vow of pacifism, swearing never again to take a life.

events.summary: On Rath Greven captures Karn and he is tortured in Volrath's Stronghold until Gerrard rescues him.
events.quote: Karn was captured by Greven as he refused to fight off his attackers

events.summary: Karn persuades the Sliver Queen to let him take the Legacy artifacts.
events.quote: Karn convinced the Sliver Queen to let him take the artifacts and depart in peace

events.summary: Confronting Tsabo Tavoc in Koilos, Karn's memories return and he helps Gerrard kill her.
events.quote: He was instrumental in helping Gerrard kill Tavoc

events.summary: Gerrard places Urza's powerstone eyes into Karn; the Legacy destroys the Phyrexians and Yawgmoth, and Karn becomes the first artificial planeswalker.
events.quote: the powerstones turned Karn into the first artificial planeswalker

events.summary: Karn creates Argentum and sends probes to Dominaria, one of which becomes the Mirari.
events.quote: Karn later created Argentum , a plane of mathematical perfection.

events.summary: Karn turns the Mirari into the golem Memnarch, whose contact with Karn's glistening oil leads him to transform Argentum into Mirrodin.
events.quote: he decided to turn Argentum into Mirrodin

events.summary: Locked out of Mirrodin, Karn sends dreams to Glissa; after Memnarch falls he turns him back into the Mirari.
events.quote: Karn turned Memnarch back into the Mirari and left it in the care of Glissa, Slobad , and Geth .

events.summary: Karn travels back in time to seal the rift over Tolaria and gives up his spark, leaving him vulnerable to Phyrexian oil.
events.quote: gave up his spark to do so before being flung back to the present

events.summary: Karn flees to Mirrodin as the oil takes hold, later worshipped as Father of Machines and trapped in his own mind as Mirrodin becomes New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Karn retreated to Mirrodin's Core , being worshipped as the new Father of Machines

events.summary: Venser gives his life and spark to Karn, who is released from Phyrexian tyranny.
events.quote: he gave his life and spark to Karn

events.summary: Karn meets Chandra in Yavimaya and agrees to help the Gatewatch against Bolas without taking the oath.
events.quote: Karn agreed to help the Gatewatch in the fight against Nicol Bolas

events.summary: Karn grants the Gatewatch and allies the ability to see planeswalker auras during the War of the Spark.
events.quote: Karn granted the Gatewatch (along with himself, Jaya , Ral , Kaya , and Teyo ) the ability to see the auras of other planeswalkers

events.summary: Karn flies an explosive micro-drone into Tezzeret's chest, collapsing the Planar Bridge.
events.quote: The portal collapsed, and the wounded Tezzeret revealed that he was glad they defeated him

events.summary: Karn delivers Hazoret's spear to the newly resurrected Niv-Mizzet.
events.quote: Karn transported it back to Ravnica and gave it to the newly resurrected Niv-Mizzet .

events.summary: In the Caves of Koilos Karn finds Sheoldred's staging ground and Rona collapses the cavern on him.
events.quote: Rona collapsed the cavern on Karn, incapacitating the golem

events.summary: Karn is captured by the compleated Ajani and Sheoldred at the Battle of the Mana Rig and brought before Elesh Norn.
events.quote: During the Battle of the Mana Rig , Karn was captured by the compleated Ajani and Sheoldred.

events.summary: Elesh Norn's Suture Priests dissect Karn on New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Elesh Norn's Suture Priests dissected him.

events.summary: Karn, broken open, urges the strike force to detonate the Sylex, and Koth offers to free him.
events.quote: Still able to talk, he encouraged the strike force to detonate the Sylex.

events.summary: Karn breaks his pacifist vows and executes the wounded Elesh Norn as New Phyrexia is consigned to the void.
events.quote: he consciously and somberly broke his pacifist vows and executed the wounded Elesh Norn

events.summary: Karn helps Melira un-compleat Ajani and Nissa, sacrificing Venser's spark to purify theirs.
events.quote: Karn helped purify their sparks by sacrificing Venser's.

relations.note: Created as a probe by Urza and Barrin.
relations.quote: Karn was created as a probe by Urza and Barrin

relations.note: In the Echoverse, Mishra built Karn from gold.
relations.quote: Karn was built from solid gold by the great planeswalker Mishra

relations.note: Karn repeated the mantra that Jhoira is his friend.
She began to teach him in earnest.
relations.quote: began to teach him in earnest

relations.note: Teferi harassed him as a toy early on.
relations.quote: Teferi saw him as an elaborate toy and endlessly harassed the golem

relations.note: Karn was always present to serve Urza.
relations.quote: Karn was always present to serve, however

relations.note: Karn rescued and cared for Gerrard.
relations.quote: brought him to his adoptive father Sidar Kondo

relations.note: Karn turned the Mirari orb into the golem Memnarch.
relations.quote: turned the orb into the golem Memnarch

relations.note: Venser sacrificed himself to free Karn.

relations.quote: Melira cleansed the golem's body of the Phyrexian taint

relations.note: As a compleated Phyrexian he captured Karn.
relations.quote: Karn was captured by the compleated Ajani and Sheoldred.

relations.note: He helped them but did not take the oath.
relations.quote: He didn't take the oath because he meant to leave soon
